md: - **Last king per the Puranas: Pulomavi III** (30th); known from the **Myakadoni** inscription. ⚠ APPSC key (2011) gave **Chandasri (Chanda Sati)**, citing the Matsya Purana.
- **Kanhabenna:** Hathigumpha's name for the **Krishna** river, to which Kharavela sent his army.
- **Begin with Gautamiputra Satakarni** (G2 2008); usual explanation: **polygamy** (princes told apart by their mothers).
- **'Rajan' title:** first used for a Satavahana ruler in a **Nasik** inscription; not Junnar, Naneghat or Karle.

- **Kotilingala (Karimnagar)**: coins of founder **Simuka**, legend "**Siri Chimuka Sata**"; **Kondapur (Medak)** = mint site.
- **Aradalam:** facial paste used by **dancers** (Gathasaptasati, Amaravati sculptures).
- **Billa Surgam:** limestone caves near **Betamcherla**; explored by **Robert Bruce Foote (1884)**; Palaeolithic tools and Pleistocene animal fossils.

| Order | Dynasty | Period | Key facts |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Ikshvakus | c. 225–325 | Capital **Vijayapuri**; ended by the Pallavas (c. 301) |
| 2 | **Brihatphalayanas** | c. 275–325 | Former Ikshvaku feudatories north of the Krishna; name from a gotra; only known king **Jayavarma** (Brahmanical, "**Maheshwara-pada-parigrahita**") |
| 3 | **Salankayanas** | c. 300–420 | Capital **Vengi (Pedavegi, Eluru district)**; early kings **Saiva** (Nandi emblem, Parama Mahesvara), later Vaishnava; plates of Tripurantakam, Denduluru, Eluru; conquered by Madhava Varma II |
| 4 | **Vishnukundins** | c. **420–624** | Rose after **Samudragupta's southern campaign (358 CE)** weakened the Pallavas |
| 5 | Eastern Chalukyas | from 624 | Founded by **Kubja Vishnuvardhana** at Vengi |
- **Salankayana:** a gotra name meaning **Nandi** (bull), matching their bull emblem; family deity **Chitrarathaswami**.
